event: Nala thanks her; if she wants the hair as an accessory, she'll have to bring Nala to the ball.
Shaestrel laughs and winds a lock of Nala's hair round one finger.
She says she'll bring Nala across the ford to the dance on Beltane night.
She tells Nala to make herself something from the spare silk, so they match.
She lets the lock go, takes Nala's hand and kisses her knuckles.
